correctness.rationale: PASS: The exponential backward recurrence age at stationarity yields trace-norm convergent ρ1=E|ψ_T><ψ_T| and ρcommon=E(|ψ_T><ψ_T|)⊗². Reset contraction gives uniqueness; the common density matrix is a mixture of product projectors, hence separable with marginals ρ1. Tight-binding spectral Fourier transform gives overlap J_0(2J(s−t)). A double-exponential age integral reduces to a one-dimensional exponential convolution: P1=E[J_0(2JT)^2], Pcommon=E[J_0(2JT)^4], Pindependent=P1². Strict Cauchy–Schwarz variance is positive because J_0 is nonconstant. Bessel addition/Laplace identities give P1~r/(2πJ) log(16J/r); uniform O(u^−1/2) Bessel decay makes C4 finite, and dominated convergence gives Pcommon~r C4/(2J). The ratio and logarithmic divergence follow. Independently checked several finite-rate Bessel integrals, equality with elliptic P1, strict ratio and small-r trend. Not Umegaki mutual information, not entanglement.

originality.rationale: PASS (qualified): Stationary Poisson-reset quantum walk density matrices and Bessel site probabilities were already developed by Wald–Böttcher and Das–Dattagupta–Gupta. The claim does not assert the one-body purity, Poisson mixing, or renewal identity individually as novel. Neither inspected primary work studies the two-copy shared-vs-independent clock comparison with coincident marginals and strict Rényi-two contrast, nor establishes the Bessel-fourth-power weak-reset logarithmic singularity. General common-random-environment correlation identities may be antecedents, so novelty is qualified to the full explicit lattice asymptotic.

value.rationale: PASS: The choice of shared versus independent stochastic reset times is an experimentally meaningful distinction invisible to every one-body stationary density matrix. The exact diverging collision-entropy contrast, together with rigorously separable joint state, gives a sharp quantitative measure of correlation induced solely by a shared classical reset clock. The interplay between marginal logarithmic Bessel divergence and integrable fourth power is a nontrivial low-rate asymptotic, not a simple restatement of stochastic mixing.

final_claim: Two distinguishable, free nearest-neighbor quantum walkers reset with a common Poisson clock have separable stationary joint density matrix and the same marginals as walkers reset independently, but strictly larger joint collision purity; the order-two entropy contrast log(P_common/P_one²)>0 diverges as log[2π² J C4/(r(log(16J/r))²)]+o(1) at fixed J>0 as r→0, where C4=∫_0^∞ J_0(u)^4du>0.
